title: Best old Japanese films in colour?

commenti.body:
Check out Kozaburo Yoshimura's Night River from 1956. 

Here's a good [letterboxd list](https://letterboxd.com/sc_elly/list/country-japan-the-fifties-top-25-colour-films/).
